thread:
Maya (Docs): Heads up — PR #4821 added an example that puts `project_id` in both the path and the request body. That contradicts our OpenAPI guidance (identifiers belong in path/query). Can we align the wording and examples?
Liam (SDK): +1. We should prefer path params for immutable identifiers. For SDK snippets we should show the path-only variant and call out legacy body usage in a migration note.
Sam (Platform): Quick question — do we want to say the server will reject a mismatched body id (400) or prefer path and ignore body if present? We need consistent runtime behavior doc too.
Rina (API): Server behavior: current implementation treats path as source-of-truth and ignores `project_id` in body (no error). But that's not obvious in the docs. We should either change runtime to 400 on mismatch or document current-ignore behavior.
Maya (Docs): Given the deployment risk, I'd prefer documenting the current-ignore behavior and adding a clear "migration" callout for clients that relied on body id. Then we can follow up with a breaking-change plan if we want to enforce 400 later.
Alex (Eng): Agree with doc-first. If we document "path wins" we should add a small test matrix to the integration tests to prevent accidental future changes. I'll add that to the infra ticket.
Liam (SDK): For code examples: update curl + python + go snippets. Example suggestion:
```
# bad (confusing)
POST /v1/projects/abcd/items
{
  "project_id": "abcd",
  "name": "widget"
}

# recommended
POST /v1/projects/abcd/items
{
  "name": "widget"
}
```
We should also add a one-line note: "Do not duplicate path parameters inside request body; the server uses the path value."
Maya (Docs): I'll draft the PR text. Also we need to update the OpenAPI examples so codegen and SDKs reflect the path-only example.
DocCI Bot: docs/pr-4821: lint error — examples/openapi/project-items.yaml: path-param duplicated in example payload (E302).
Maya (Docs): Thanks, DocCI. I'll fix the example file.
Rina (API): Ping @Liam — when you update SDK snippets, please make sure the Go example doesn't reuse the older `ProjectID` field in the request struct; we renamed it earlier.
Liam (SDK): Got it. I'll update: use `CreateItemRequest{Name: "widget"}` and call `client.CreateItem(ctx, "abcd", req)` to show path param separate from body.
Sam (Platform): Also create a small migration note block: bullet list — what to do if you previously relied on body id, expected 400 vs ignored, recommended rollout plan. Keep it short.
Maya (Docs): Drafted migration note (short): "If you previously supplied `project_id` in the body, move it to the path. The server currently ignores the body `project_id`; to avoid surprises, check your client to stop sending duplicate ids. Future behavior may enforce mismatch errors — subscribe to changelog." Thoughts?
Alex (Eng): Good. Add a link to the infra ticket: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/issues/912 (tests for path-vs-body).
Maya (Docs): I'll push an amended example and the migration note in PR #4821. Will request review from @Rina and @Liam.
Liam (SDK): I'll review after you push, can also update SDK snippets in a follow-up PR if needed.
Rina (API): If possible, add a tiny note in the OpenAPI schema description for the `project_id` path param: "Used as the authoritative identifier for the request." That helps generators.
Maya (Docs): Nice call — adding that now.
DocCI Bot: docs/pr-4821: CI passed on examples/openapi/project-items.yaml after fix. :white_check_mark:
Maya (Docs): PR updated: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4821 — includes updated curl/py/go snippets, migration note, and OpenAPI example fix. Requesting reviewers: @Rina, @Liam.
Rina (API): Reviewing now. Quick comment: can you add a one-line sentence in the top-level API ref page about "path params are authoritative" so it's discoverable?
Maya (Docs): Added that sentence and a small cross-link to the migration note.
Liam (SDK): Reviewed + left a tiny nit about `context.Background()` vs `ctx` in Go snippet.
Maya (Docs): Fixed nit and pushed.
Sam (Platform): Thanks everyone. Once Rina approves, I'll queue the infra test and we can merge. :+1:
